key_reasoning.reason: New GET /v1/analytics/assistants-requests router endpoint, AnalyticsService passthrough and AssistantHandler.get_assistants_requests, plus extensions to shared analytics plumbing used by every analytics endpoint: MetricsElasticRepository search (optional sort / track_total_hits), AnalyticsQueryPipeline (new hit-row search path, assistant_id filter) and SecureQueryBuilder (add_assistant_filter). Base M across API/Service/Repository, bumped to L for touching shared utilities.
13 files changed (diffstat), mapped to XL. Only 6 are source files; 7 are tests plus the OpenAPI baseline, so the implementation footprint is closer to M than the file count suggests.

Closest pattern is the existing aggregation-based analytics endpoints; this adds a document-hit paging path with a 10,000 result-window guard (HTTP 400) and deterministic sort, which is a modest new approach. Access control reuses the existing SecureQueryBuilder project/user scoping, so no security gap; read-only, trivially reversible.
Behaviour is precisely specified in the endpoint description (field availability, paging limit, reconciliation with assistants-chats); only minor semantic caveats remained.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from M to L: touches core shared analytics utilities (metrics repository search, query pipeline, secure query builder)
